description: Register 1 (TESTREG, variant 10) delivers VALUE (member 1001, variable 101) in 2020. Three codebooks in the SOS fetch layout (code,label,label_en,parent_code,valid_from,valid_to): tree.csv, a tree under two roots whose child rows come before their parents, plus one parentless code; flat.csv, whose parent_code cells name chapter 01, which is no code of the book (KS87-P's shape); broken.csv, whose code 12 names parent 9, which is no code of the book.
